concerns.text: Data‑model schema for Molecular Graph (contracts/dataset.schema.yaml) requires a `num_neighbors` field for each node, but Task T011 only lists atomic_number, hybridization, and formal_charge. The generated graph objects will not validate against the schema.

The Molecular Graph schema also mandates a `similarity_score` per molecule. The plan’s scaffold‑split task (T013) mentions filtering by Tanimoto similarity but does not record the resulting score in the graph objects, violating the schema.

Contract `contracts/checksums.schema.yaml` expects `checksums.json` to be an array of objects with `file_path` and `sha256`. The plan creates an empty JSON object `{}` in Task T003, which will fail schema validation in Task T007.

`contracts/metrics.schema.yaml` requires an `interpretability` block containing `alignment_score`, `top_features`, and `reference_source_type`. Task T031 only writes `alignment_score` to `metrics.json`; the other required fields are missing, causing schema non‑compliance.

`contracts/output.schema.yaml` specifies a JSON `predictions` array with per‑model fields (ground_truth, spectral_gnn_pred, etc.). The plan generates `predictions.parquet` (binary) and does not produce a JSON file matching the contract, so the final output will not satisfy the contract.

Principle IV (Single Source of Truth) requires every figure/metric to trace back to exactly one data row and one code block. The plan only mentions running an SSoT validator (T033) but does not designate a concrete SSoT artifact (e.g., a manifest) linking each metric to its source, leaving the principle unverified.
